newsitem.title: USA: Paxson in talks to buy Dow TV station - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Paxson in talks to buy Dow TV station - NYT.

text.p: Paxson Communications is in negotiations to purchase New York City television station WBIS, which is owned by Dow Jones & Co and ITT Corp, the New York Times reported on Tuesday.
According to a person with knowledge of the talks, the price was said to be about $250 million, the paper said.

But a Paxson spokesman was quoted in the paper as denying the company was making a bid, while Dow Jones was quoted as declining to comment. The Times also quoted an ITT spokesman as saying ITT was in talks with a number of possible bidders but declined to elaborate.
The ITT-Dow Jones partnership bought the station, Channel 31, from New York City in August 1995 for $207 million, the paper said.
None of the companies were immediately available to further comment on the Times report.
